headline: NCLT Mumbai approves resolution plan for KSS Limited; Regulation 30 intimation filed
sum: NCLT Mumbai Bench, Court-V approved the resolution plan for KSS Limited on 5 August 2026, with the company filing a Regulation 30 disclosure on 7 August 2026. The order gives consequential effect to the plan under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
detail: KSS Limited, a listed company, underwent a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The NCLT Mumbai Bench (Court-V) issued an order on 5 August 2026 approving the resolution plan submitted during the CIRP and passing consequential orders to give effect to it. The company's disclosure to NSE on 7 August 2026 under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015 intimated this order. The approval concludes the insolvency proceedings and binds all creditors and stakeholders to the terms of the approved resolution plan.
